006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.format;
007
008import org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager;
009import org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger;
010
011import java.util.List;
012
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IAssemblyInstanceGroupedNodeItem;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IAssemblyNodeItem;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDocumentNodeItem;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFieldNodeItem;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFlagNodeItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModelNodeItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IRootAssemblyNodeItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFlagInstance;
022import dev.metaschema.core.model.INamedModelInstance;
023import dev.metaschema.core.model.JsonGroupAsBehavior;
024import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
025import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
026import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
027
028/**
029 * An {@link IPathFormatter} that produces RFC 6901 compliant JSON Pointer
030 * paths.
031 * <p>
032 * This formatter produces paths suitable for use with JSON tooling and
033 * JSON-based error reporting. The format follows the JSON Pointer specification
034 * (RFC 6901).
035 * <p>
036 * Example output: {@code /catalog/controls/0/id}
037 * <p>
038 * Key characteristics:
039 * <ul>
040 * <li>Uses JSON property names (not XML element names)</li>
041 * <li>Uses 0-based array indices for LIST grouping</li>
042 * <li>Uses key values for KEYED grouping</li>
043 * <li>Handles SINGLETON_OR_LIST by checking sibling count</li>
044 * <li>Escapes special characters per RFC 6901 (~ as ~0, / as ~1)</li>
045 * <li>No @ prefix for flags (unlike XPath)</li>
046 * </ul>
047 *
048 * @see <a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6901">RFC 6901 - JSON
049 *      Pointer</a>
050 */
051public class JsonPointerFormatter implements IPathFormatter {
052  private static final Logger LOGGER = LogManager.getLogger(JsonPointerFormatter.class);
053
054  @Override
055  @NonNull
056  public String formatMetaschema(IModuleNodeItem metaschema) {
057    // Returns empty string to produce leading "/" via join in format method
058    return "";
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  @NonNull
063  public String formatDocument(IDocumentNodeItem document) {
064    // Returns empty string to produce leading "/" via join in format method
065    return "";
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  @NonNull
070  public String formatRootAssembly(IRootAssemblyNodeItem root) {
071    String jsonName = root.getDefinition().getJsonName();
072    return escapeJsonPointer(jsonName);
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  @NonNull
077  public String formatAssembly(IAssemblyNodeItem assembly) {
078    return formatModelItem(assembly);
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  @NonNull
083  public String formatAssembly(IAssemblyInstanceGroupedNodeItem assembly) {
084    return formatModelItem(assembly);
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  @NonNull
089  public String formatField(IFieldNodeItem field) {
090    return formatModelItem(field);
091  }
092
093  @Override
094  @NonNull
095  public String formatFlag(IFlagNodeItem flag) {
096    // JSON Pointer does not use @ prefix for attributes
097    return escapeJsonPointer(flag.getQName().getLocalName());
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Format a model node item (assembly or field) based on its JSON grouping
102   * behavior.
103   *
104   * @param item
105   *          the model node item to format
106   * @return the formatted path segment
107   */
108  @NonNull
109  private static String formatModelItem(@NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item) {
110    INamedModelInstance instance = item.getInstance();
111    if (instance == null) {
112      // No instance - use local name only
113      return escapeJsonPointer(item.getQName().getLocalName());
114    }
115
116    String jsonName = escapeJsonPointer(instance.getJsonName());
117    JsonGroupAsBehavior behavior = instance.getJsonGroupAsBehavior();
118
119    switch (behavior) {
120    case KEYED:
121      String keyValue = getJsonKeyValue(item, instance);
122      return jsonName + "/" + escapeJsonPointer(keyValue);
123    case LIST:
124      // 0-based index
125      return jsonName + "/" + (item.getPosition() - 1);
126    case SINGLETON_OR_LIST:
127      int siblingCount = countSiblings(item);
128      if (siblingCount > 1) {
129        // Multiple siblings - use array notation
130        return jsonName + "/" + (item.getPosition() - 1);
131      }
132      // Single sibling - no index
133      return jsonName;
134    case NONE:
135    default:
136      return jsonName;
137    }
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Get the JSON key value for a KEYED collection item.
142   *
143   * @param item
144   *          the model node item
145   * @param instance
146   *          the model instance
147   * @return the key value, or falls back to 0-based index if not available
148   */
149  @NonNull
150  private static String getJsonKeyValue(
151      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item,
152      @NonNull INamedModelInstance instance) {
153    IFlagInstance keyFlag = instance.getEffectiveJsonKey();
154    if (keyFlag != null) {
155      IEnhancedQName keyFlagQName = keyFlag.getQName();
156      IFlagNodeItem flagItem = item.getFlagByName(keyFlagQName);
157      if (flagItem != null) {
158        return flagItem.toAtomicItem().asString();
159      }
160    }
161    // Fallback to 0-based index - this indicates a potential issue with the model
162    // or data
163    if (LOGGER.isWarnEnabled()) {
164      LOGGER.warn("Unable to resolve JSON key for KEYED collection item '{}', falling back to numeric index",
165          item.getQName().getLocalName());
166    }
167    return ObjectUtils.notNull(String.valueOf(item.getPosition() - 1));
168  }
169
170  /**
171   * Count the number of siblings with the same name as the given item.
172   *
173   * @param item
174   *          the model node item
175   * @return the sibling count (including the item itself)
176   */
177  private static int countSiblings(@NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item) {
178    IAssemblyNodeItem parent = item.getParentContentNodeItem();
179    if (parent == null) {
180      return 1;
181    }
182    List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> siblings = parent.getModelItemsByName(item.getQName());
183    return siblings.size();
184  }
185
186  /**
187   * Escape a string value according to RFC 6901.
188   * <p>
189   * The order of escaping is important: ~ must be escaped first, then /.
190   *
191   * @param value
192   *          the value to escape
193   * @return the escaped value
194   */
195  @NonNull
196  private static String escapeJsonPointer(@NonNull String value) {
197    // Order matters: escape ~ first, then /
198    return ObjectUtils.notNull(value.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1"));
199  }
200}
